composition_variation: Depict Giyu Tomioka standing beneath a quiet wooden veranda, wearing his distinctive two-pattern haori over a fully closed everyday outfit. Both hands cradle a warm ceramic tea cup at chest level. Keep his expression reserved but peaceful. Use cinematic slate blue rain, desaturated burgundy fabric, small amber window reflections, and a central close three-quarter portrait. Show no scabbards, swords, or equipment. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
